name: Telegram
description: Chat with your bots from a private Telegram chat. Approve actions with a tap, get files and job results, and switch bots with /bots.

configuration.label: Bot token
configuration.description: In Telegram, message @BotFather, send /newbot and follow the steps. Paste the token it gives you. Use a bot that no other program is connected to.

configuration.label: Your Telegram user ID
configuration.description: Only this account can talk to your bot. If you don’t know your ID, leave this empty, enable the plugin and send your bot any message: it replies with the number to enter here.
